title: Presidents’ Day in the US
credits: Hai Do wrote this story for VOA Learning English. Ashley Thompson was the editor.

sentences.en: The third Monday of February is known as Presidents’ Day in the United States.
sentences.zh: 二月的第三个星期一在美国被称为“总统日”。

sentences.en: For nearly 100 years, America honored its first president, George Washington, on February 22.
sentences.zh: 近100年来，美国在2月22日纪念它的第一任总统乔治·华盛顿。

sentences.en: That was his birthday.
sentences.zh: 那天是他的生日。

sentences.en: But the date was not a national holiday until 1968.
sentences.zh: 但直到1968年，这个日期才成为全国性节日。

sentences.en: That year, the U.S. Congress passed a measure known as the Uniform Monday Holiday Act.
sentences.zh: 那一年，美国国会通过了一项被称为“统一周一假期法”的措施。

sentences.en: The measure meant that some public holidays would always fall on a Monday.
sentences.zh: 这项措施意味着一些公共假期将始终落在星期一。

sentences.en: Today, the country honors its first president on the third Monday in February -- and not on Washington’s real birthday.
sentences.zh: 如今，美国在二月的第三个星期一纪念它的第一任总统——而不是在华盛顿真正的生日那天。

sentences.en: The holiday is now commonly called Presidents’ Day.
sentences.zh: 这个节日现在通常被称为“总统日”。

sentences.en: Many say it also honors Abraham Lincoln’s birthday.
sentences.zh: 许多人说，它也是纪念亚伯拉罕·林肯生日的日子。

sentences.en: The nation’s 16th president was born on February 12.
sentences.zh: 这位国家的第十六任总统出生于2月12日。

sentences.en: The federal government, however, still recognizes the holiday as “Washington’s Birthday.”
sentences.zh: 然而，联邦政府仍然将这一节日认定为“华盛顿生日”。

sentences.en: The Uniform Monday Holiday Act gives workers a three-day weekend.
sentences.zh: “统一周一假期法”给工人们带来了三天的周末。

sentences.en: It also gives shops and marketers a chance to have special Presidents’ Day sales.
sentences.zh: 它也给了商店和营销人员一次举办特别的“总统日”促销活动的机会。

sentences.en: In January of 2021, Joe Biden made history when he took the oath of office as the 46th president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 在2021年1月，乔·拜登在就任美国第46任总统时宣誓就职，创造了历史。

sentences.en: At 78 years old, he became the oldest elected president.
sentences.zh: 78岁的他成为了最年长的当选总统。

sentences.en: The man he beat was the previous record holder, Donald J. Trump.
sentences.zh: 被他击败的人是上一位纪录保持者唐纳德·J·特朗普。

sentences.en: He took office at the age of 70 in 2017.
sentences.zh: 他在2017年以70岁的年龄就职。

sentences.en: Biden and Trump are leading candidates for the Democratic and Republican presidential nominations for the 2024 presidential race.
sentences.zh: 拜登和特朗普是2024年总统大选民主党与共和党总统候选人的热门人选。

sentences.en: They will likely face each other again later this year for the presidency.
sentences.zh: 今年晚些时候，他们很可能再次在总统宝座上相遇。

sentences.en: As the first billionaire president, Trump replaced John F.
sentences.zh: 作为首位亿万富翁总统，特朗普取代了约翰·F.

sentences.en: Kennedy, the 35th president, as the richest man to serve as president.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪，第35任总统，是担任总统期间最富有的人。

sentences.en: Kennedy still holds the record for the youngest person to be elected president.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪仍保持着当选总统最年轻者的纪录。

sentences.en: He was 43 when he took office.
sentences.zh: 他就任时43岁。

sentences.en: Kennedy is also the youngest president to die in office.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪也是就任期间去世的最年轻总统。

sentences.en: He was assassinated in 1963 in Dallas, Texas.
sentences.zh: 他于1963年在得克萨斯州达拉斯遇刺身亡。

sentences.en: He was 46 years old.
sentences.zh: 当时他46岁。

sentences.en: Another presidential assassination put the youngest person in the office of the president.
sentences.zh: 另一次总统遇刺事件让最年轻的人进入了总统之位。

sentences.en: In 1901, Theodore Roosevelt, then the vice president, became president at the age of 42.
sentences.zh: 1901年，时任副西奥多·罗斯福以42岁的年龄成为总统。

sentences.en: He took office after William McKinley, the 25th president, was shot and killed in Buffalo, New York.
sentences.zh: 他在第25任总统威廉·麦金莱于纽约州布法罗被枪杀后接任总统。

sentences.en: The first president to die in office, though, was William Henry Harrison.
sentences.zh: 不过，第一位就任期间去世的总统是威廉·亨利·哈里森。

sentences.en: The country’s ninth president only served 32 days, the shortest time of any president.
sentences.zh: 这位国家第九任总统仅在位32天，是任何总统中在位时间最短的。

sentences.en: Another Roosevelt holds the record for the longest time in office.
sentences.zh: 另一位罗斯福保持着在位时间最长的纪录。

sentences.en: Franklin Delano Roosevelt was the 32nd president.
sentences.zh: 富兰克林·德拉诺·罗斯福是第32任总统。

sentences.en: He held office for 4,422 days.
sentences.zh: 他在位4422天。

sentences.en: After his death, the 22nd Amendment was passed.
sentences.zh: 他去世后，第22条修正案获得通过。

sentences.en: It limited a person to two four-year terms as president.
sentences.zh: 它将总统任期限制为两个四年任期。

sentences.en: Most Americans know that the two Roosevelts were related.
sentences.zh: 大多数美国人都知道这两位罗斯福是亲戚。

sentences.en: But they may not know exactly how they were related.
sentences.zh: 但他们未必清楚他们究竟是如何亲属关系。

sentences.en: Here it goes:
sentences.zh: 情况是这样的：

sentences.en: Franklin Roosevelt’s wife, Eleanor Roosevelt was also his fifth cousin once removed.
sentences.zh: 富兰克林·罗斯福的妻子埃莉诺·罗斯福也是他的第五代旁系血亲隔了一代。

sentences.en: And Theodore Roosevelt, the 26th president, was Eleanor’s uncle.
sentences.zh: 西奥多·罗斯福，第26任总统，是埃莉诺的叔叔。

sentences.en: That makes the two presidents distant relatives.
sentences.zh: 这就使这两位总统成为远房亲戚。

sentences.en: But they were not the first relatives to both serve as president.
sentences.zh: 但他们并不是第一批都做总统的亲属。

sentences.en: That title belongs to the Adamses.
sentences.zh: 这个称号属于亚当斯家族。

sentences.en: John Adams was America’s second president.
sentences.zh: 约翰·亚当斯是美国的第二任总统。

sentences.en: His son, John Quincy Adams was elected as the nation’s sixth president.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子约翰·昆西·亚当斯当选为国家的第四任总统。

sentences.en: The Bushes are the other father-son presidential pair.
sentences.zh: 布什家族是另一对父子总统组合。

sentences.en: George Herbert Walker Bush was elected as the 41st president.
sentences.zh: 乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什当选为第41任总统。

sentences.en: His son, George W.
sentences.zh: 他的儿子，乔治·W·

sentences.en: Bush, was the country’s 43rd president.
sentences.zh: 布什，是该国的第43任总统。

sentences.en: Not everyone can run for president.
sentences.zh: 不是每个人都能竞选总统。

sentences.en: The U.S. Constitution says a person must be at least 35 years old.
sentences.zh: 美国宪法规定，一个人必须至少35岁。

sentences.en: A person must also have lived “within the United States” for at least 14 years.
sentences.zh: 一个人还必须"在美国境内"居住至少14年。

sentences.en: And they must be a “natural-born citizen.”
sentences.zh: 而且他们必须是"自然出生的公民"。

sentences.en: But the meaning of “natural-born citizen” is not exactly clear.
sentences.zh: 但"自然出生的公民"的含义并不完全清楚。

sentences.en: People read the rules in different ways.
sentences.zh: 人们对规则有不同的解读。

sentences.en: By some reasoning, the first “natural-born” American president was not George Washington or John Adams.
sentences.zh: 根据某种推理，第一位"自然出生"的美国总统不是乔治·华盛顿或约翰·亚当斯。

sentences.en: It was Martin Van Buren, the eighth president.
sentences.zh: 而是马丁·范布伦，第八任总统。

sentences.en: He was born in 1782, six years after the signing of the Declaration of Independence.
sentences.zh: 他出生于1782年，在《独立宣言》签署后的第六年。

sentences.en: All seven presidents before Van Buren, and William Henry Harrison, the 9th president, technically were not “natural-born” citizens.
sentences.zh: 在范布伦之前的七位总统，以及第九任总统威廉·亨利·哈里森，从技术上来说都不是"自然出生的公民"。

sentences.en: They were born before 1776 when the American states were still British colonies.
sentences.zh: 他们出生于1776年以前，那时美国各州还是英国的殖民地。

sentences.en: I'm Ashley Thompson.
sentences.zh: 我是艾希莉·汤普森。

glossary.zh: 堂（表）兄弟姐妹；表（堂）亲属

glossary.def: used to describe a relative who is not closely related
two people who are related in some way or who do something together
